fields.label: Caveats
items: BigQuery access can incur charges. Prefer the free REST API (AGENT_RULES: no paid jobs).
RTT isn't one-way delay. Keep MEASURED_LATENCY separate from MODELLED_LATENCY.
Terms are versioned and need re-acceptance. Read the current terms page directly before use (lane A only saw them via search).
